Open Farm Satisfaction Guarantee for Online Orders

At Open Farm, we understand that trying new pet food can feel like a big leap — especially when it comes to your furry family member’s health and happiness. That’s why we’re excited to offer our 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee for first-time customers and existing customers looking to explore new recipes!

Love It or Your Money Back

We offer a 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee on eligible Open Farm recipes purchased through openfarmpet.com or authorized retailers. If you or your pet are not completely satisfied within 30 days (from delivery for openfarmpet.com orders or purchase for authorized retailers), we’ll make it right with a refund or exchange.

Refunds are issued back to the original payment method used at checkout; for openfarmpet.com orders we can process your refund directly, while retailer purchases follow the retailer’s return policy (and we’re happy to help if you need guidance).

Refund eligibility is limited to one (1) refund per SKU (item) per customer or household; proof of donation may be requested before a refund is issued, and approval is subject to purchase verification and at the discretion of our Pet Parent Experience Team.

Need help choosing? We’re here for you

Before you place your order, our Feeding Experts are here to help you find the best fit for your pet. Tell us a little about your pet, and we’ll guide you to the right options so you can choose with confidence. Reach out to us anytime!

Feeding Guidelines

Below are feeding guidelines only. Adjust the feeding amount based on your dog’s weight and activity level. Serve as a complete, balanced meal or nutritious topper.

Suitable For: Adult Dogs, Senior Dogs
Weight(lbs): Less Active 16oz Pouches/Day: More Active 16oz Pouches/Day:
10 lbs ½ ⅗
15 lbs ⅗ ¾
20 lbs ¾ 1
25 lbs ⅞ 1¼
30 lbs 1 1⅓
40 lbs 1¼ 1⅔
50 lbs 1½ 2
60 lbs 1⅔ 2¼
70 lbs 1⅞ 2½
80 lbs 2 2¾

Increase daily feeding by 3oz or 1/2 cup for every additional 10 lbs of body weight. Store in freezer and thaw prior to use. Once thawed, keep refrigerated in a sealed container for up to 5 days. Always provide access to fresh water.

Ingredients

This ingredient list reflects from our most recent lot. To view sourcing information about your specific bag, check out our transparency tool

Ingredient

Origin

G.A.P. Step 2 Chicken

United States, California

Chicken is a great source of protein and healthy fats. Our chicken is raised on farms that are certified to Global Animal Partnership’s (G.A.P.) Step 2 – Enriched Environment animal welfare standard. This means they are humanely raised with space to roam, natural light, and enrichments, raised without antibiotics, and fed a vegetarian diet.

Carrots

Canada, Prince Edward, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick

Carrots are a good source of vitamin A from beta-carotene, bitamin B6, biotin, and fiber. Our carrots are non-GMO.

Kale

United States, South Carolina

Kale is a good source of vitamins A, B7 (biotin), C, K, minerals like folate, calcium, potassium, manganese, and antioxidants like carotenoids including lutein, zeaxanthin, and fiber.

Butternut Squash

Argentina

Butternut squash contains vitamin C, vitamin A, and potassium. Our butternut squash is non-GMO.

Apples

United States, New York

Apples are a good source of potassium, vitamin C and fiber. They also contain antioxidants including phytochemicals. Our apples are non-GMO.

Coconut Oil

Philippines / Sri Lanka

Coconut oil contains medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), it is an excellent palatant and is high in lauric acid. Coconut oil can be preserved with mixed tocopherols.

Pumpkin

United States, Arkansas, Missouri

Pumpkin is a good source of vitamins A and C, minerals like potassium, antioxidants, fiber and beta-carotene. Our pumpkin in non-GMO.

Water

United States

Water is a source of moisture, used when cooking our stews, blends, and gently cooked recipes.

Wild-Alaskan Salmon Oil

United States, Alaska

Salmon oil is a great source of omega-3 fatty acids, notably EPA and DHA.

Flaxseed

United States, North Dakota, South Dakota

Flaxseed is a good source of vitamins B1 (thiamin) and B6 (pyridoxine), minerals like magnesium and phosphorus, omega-3 fatty acids, and high in fiber. Flaxseed is used in our products to help balance the dietary omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acid ratio required to support a healthy skin and coat.

Tricalcium Phosphate

United States, Illinois

Tricalcium phosphate provides calcium to support healthy bones. We use it to help maintain the right ratio of calcium and phosphorus for optimum pet health.

Salt

United States, Michigan

Salt helps maintain the proper balance in the body as well as supporting healthy digestion. It is an essential nutrient made up of sodium and chloride with trace minerals required to maintain optimal pet health.

Choline Chloride

United States, Missouri

Choline chloride is important for the overall support of maintaining a healthy metabolism. It is needed to maintain optimal pet health.

Chia Seeds

Paraguay / Argentina

Chia Seeds are an excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids, and provide fiber, iron, and calcium. Fiber can support gastrointestinal health.

Dried Chicory Root

Belgium

Chicory root is a natural source of insoluble fiber, and inulin, a soluble fiber which serves as a prebiotic, feeding the gut bacteria to support gastrointestinal health. Our chicory root is non-GMO.

Potassium Chloride

Germany

Potassium chloride is a supplement to help pets achieve optimal levels of potassium, an essential nutrient.

Vitamin E Supplement

Spain

Vitamin E is helps support healthy skin and circulatory health.

Vitamin A Supplement

Denmark / Poland

Vitamin A is a fat-soluble vitamin needed by pets to help support healthy vision, skin, bones, and other tissues in the body.

Niacin Supplement

Poland

Niacin is an essential vitamin. It helps support good digestive health. As a B vitamin, it also supports skin and coat health.

Pantothenic Acid

Poland

Pantothenic acid is involved in the metabolism of protein, carbohydrates, and fats and is essential for the support of healthy skin and coat.

Riboflavin Supplement

Poland

Riboflavin (B2) helps support the health of your pet and to support healthy skin and coat.

Vitamin D3 Supplement

Denmark

Vitamin D3 is an essential vitamin for the support of healthy bones.

Thiamine Mononitrate

Frequently
Asked
Questions

How are Open Farm's Freshly Crafted recipes cooked?

Our Freshly Crafted recipes are freshly prepared with human-grade ingredients in a human-grade facility, then slow-cooked at low temperatures using a steam sous vide method. This slow cooking process kills bacteria pathogens while not compromising on the recipes nutrients and flavor.

What makes Open Farm's Freshly Crafted recipes different from other fresh food?

Our recipes are freshly crafted with human-grade ingredients – but we didn't stop there. We went a step further to ensure our proteins are third party certified and all of our fruits and veggies are non-GMO. We believe that the better the quality of life of farm animals, the better the quality of meat (and therefore, better nutrition) that ends up in your pet's bowl. Third party certifications add another layer of validation (and peace of mind!) for pet parents.

We also believe that every ingredient your pet eats should be accounted for, that's why every ingredient in our Freshly Crafted recipes is 100% traceable. You can trace every ingredient to its geographic origin, see safety test results, and more. We know you're obsessed about your pet, so we obsessed about transparency in the food they eat. That's the Open Farm difference.

What is the difference between home-cooked dog food and Open Farm's Freshly Crafted?

Home-cooked dog food isn't just messy and time-consuming – it's hard to know whether you're truly giving your dog the complete and balanced nutrition it needs. Open Farm Freshly Crafted recipes are complete and balanced in the right ratios of essential micro- and macro-nutrients, formulated to meet or exceed the nutritional levels established by AAFCO.

In a wide range of easy-to-serve formats and textures, Open Farm has completely taken the guesswork and hassle out of home-cooking.

What if this Freshly Crafted recipe isn't right for my dog?

We’ve got you covered! We understand that trying new pet food and treats can be a big decision. That's why we offer a 30-day Satisfaction Guarantee for pet parents who are exploring new recipes. If you or your pet isn’t completely satisfied for any reason, our feeding experts are here to help you find the perfect recipe for your pet.

How do I know which Freshly Crafted recipe is right for my dog?

Every Freshly Crafted recipe maintains our same strict standards – 100% traceable, human-grade ingredients crafted with a blend of 3rd party certified proteins and non-GMO fruits, veggies, and superfoods. Here's a quick breakdown of our wide range of serving styles and protein options:

1. Freshly Crafted Meatballs: Ready-to-serve in a super convenient meatball format. No cutting, scooping, or prep-work required!

2. Goodbowl with Grains: This simple scoop and serve recipe includes wholesome grains.

3. Grain-Free: A scoop and serve recipe formulated without grains.

4. Goodbowl Rolls: Simply slice and serve this fun roll format, formulated with wholesome grains.

Does this recipe provide complete and balanced nutrition?

All our Freshly Crafted recipes are vet approved, offering complete and balanced nutrition with the essential macro- and micro-nutrients your pet needs to thrive. While this recipe can be served as a complete and balanced meal, it can also be mixed in with your favorite diet at meal time as a delicious topper that boosts their bowl with Freshly Crafted nutrition. As part of our 100% transparency commitment to pet parents, you can see complete ingredients and nutritional information on the product page for every recipe.

What is a Freshly Crafted meal plan and what are the benefits?

Our personalized meal plans bring Freshly Crafted nutrition to your pet’s bowl with perfectly-timed deliveries that meet their daily caloric needs. Vet nutritionist approved, our Freshly Crafted meal plans use a variety of factors to recommend recipes, daily caloric needs, and feeding guidelines based on your dog's unique needs and preferences. Depending on their lifestage, these factors include age, activity level, weight, and body type.

Save on their first box and enjoy:
- Perfectly-timed, automatic deliveries
- No commitment, cancel anytime
- Free shipping always
